text:
Shane Pinto played his 300th NHL game on Nov. 7, and the Senators are leaning on him more than ever. He plays almost 20 minutes a night as a center who kills penalties, and he has 14 points in 18 games, 7 goals and 7 assists.

The recent run has been about goals. Pinto scored in five of his last six games, including the tying goal against Buffalo on Nov. 4 and a goal and an assist against Utah. He is shooting 20.6%, higher than he usually does, though his 7 goals are close to his 6.3 expected goals, so the finishing is not wildly out of line. He just is not shooting much: 34 shots in 18 games.

The five-on-five picture is close to even, with Ottawa at about 51% of expected goals when he plays. Evolving-Hockey noted last season that strong linemates flattered his raw numbers. He ranks 36th of 506 skaters in wins added by his goals, which says the goals have come at useful moments. If the shot volume rises, this is a real step.
headline: Pinto is quietly scoring in big minutes
